headline: Regency Ceramics submits AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: Procedural compliance filing from Regency Ceramics
summary: Regency Ceramics Limited has submitted its annual general meeting scrutinizer report and voting results to the stock exchange following the meeting held on September 30, 2026. This is a standard corporate governance filing required for listed entities. Retail investors can review the voting outcomes for any resolution passed during the meeting on the exchange portal. The filing carries no immediate financial impact on the company's valuation or operations.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on share price.
